FINAL EXECUTION BLOCK — COMPLETE AUTONOMOUS DEPLOYMENT AND REMOVE RORK

OWNER DIRECTIVE

Finish the remaining production-safe work now.

Do not return another audit-only report.
Do not stop at a checkpoint.
Do not claim PASS without live evidence.

Complete this exact chain:

FIX WORKER RUNTIME
→ TEST
→ COMMIT
→ PUSH
→ CI GREEN
→ DEPLOY
→ OWNER AUTHORIZE
→ QA JOB
→ DEPLOYMENT JOB
→ REPLAY TEST
→ PROOF LEDGER
→ REMOVE RORK LEGACY ITEMS
→ FINAL REGRESSION
→ VERIFIED PASS

==================================================
1. FIX THE WORKER HANG
==================================================

Current verified blocker:

- Owner-authorized QA job was created.
- Job reached VERIFYING / Running lint.
- The lint subprocess hung.
- Owner cancellation worked.
- Final status became cancelled/FAILED.
- Existing spawn timeout does not reliably terminate the full process tree.

Locate the exact command runner used by:

ivx-senior-dev-01

Return:

- File
- Function
- Line range
- Current process-spawn method
- Current timeout logic
- Current cancellation logic

Replace the current timeout implementation with an explicit watchdog.

Required behavior:

1. Launch the command in its own process group.
2. Start an explicit watchdog timer.
3. On timeout:
   - send SIGTERM to the full process group
   - wait a short grace period
   - send SIGKILL if any process remains
4. Clear all timers and listeners.
5. Capture sanitized stdout/stderr tails.
6. Prevent orphaned child processes.
7. Prevent zombie processes.
8. Return exactly one terminal result.
9. Allow the queue to continue with the next job.

Structured timeout result:

{
  "status": "timed_out",
  "command": "<sanitized>",
  "timeoutMs": 0,
  "exitCode": null,
  "signal": "SIGTERM or SIGKILL",
  "startedAt": "<timestamp>",
  "endedAt": "<timestamp>",
  "stdoutTail": "<sanitized>",
  "stderrTail": "<sanitized>"
}

==================================================
2. FIX OWNER CANCELLATION
==================================================

When the owner cancels a job:

- stop the active command
- terminate the full subprocess tree
- prevent the next stage from starting
- write one cancelled terminal state
- write cancellation to the proof ledger
- release any queue lock
- allow the next queued job to execute

Do not write both FAILED and CANCELLED terminal records.

Use one documented final state.

==================================================
3. ADD REGRESSION TESTS
==================================================

Add tests for:

1. Command completes successfully.
2. Command exits non-zero.
3. Command never terminates.
4. Command spawns a child that never terminates.
5. Owner cancels during execution.
6. SIGTERM ends the process group.
7. SIGKILL is required after grace period.
8. No orphaned child remains.
9. Only one terminal job state is written.
10. Queue proceeds to the next job.
11. Proof ledger records timeout.
12. Proof ledger records cancellation.
13. Worker restart does not re-run completed/cancelled jobs.

Required result:

- Existing HMAC suite: PASS
- Watchdog tests: PASS
- Cancellation tests: PASS
- Process-tree cleanup tests: PASS
- Queue recovery tests: PASS
- Proof-ledger tests: PASS

==================================================
4. RUN THE FULL PRE-DEPLOYMENT GATE
==================================================

Run:

- lint
- typecheck
- unit tests
- integration tests
- worker authorization tests
- watchdog tests
- cancellation tests
- security scan
- secret scan
- dependency audit
- Rork independence guard
- backend build
- worker build
- website build
- Expo validation
- Android release consistency
- iOS configuration validation

Do not weaken or skip any mandatory check.

Return:

- Command
- Exit code
- Duration
- PASS / FAIL
- Log reference

==================================================
5. COMMIT AND PUSH
==================================================

Repository:

ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform

Branch:

main

Commit the worker runtime repair and all required tests.

Return:

- Files changed
- Commit message
- Commit SHA
- Push status
- GitHub main HEAD SHA

==================================================
6. REQUIRE GREEN CI
==================================================

Run the real GitHub Actions workflow on the new SHA.

Required jobs:

- Backend tests
- Android release consistency
- Type checks
- Security scan
- Secret scan
- Independence audit
- Worker runtime tests
- Build validation

If any required job fails:

- identify the exact error
- fix it
- commit
- push
- rerun CI

Repeat until green.

Return:

- Workflow run ID
- Commit SHA
- Each job result
- Final status
- Start/end timestamps

==================================================
7. DEPLOY THE FIXED SHA
==================================================

Deploy the exact green SHA to the existing services only:

API:
ivx-holdings-platform

Worker:
ivx-senior-dev-01

Website:
existing IVX production website service, only if changed

Do not create duplicate services.
Do not deploy an old SHA.
Do not bypass CI.

Return:

- API service ID
- API deployment ID
- API live SHA
- Worker service ID
- Worker deployment ID
- Worker live SHA
- Website deployment ID
- GitHub HEAD SHA
- Deployment timestamps

All applicable SHAs must match.

==================================================
8. RUN A CONTROLLED TIMEOUT DRILL
==================================================

Create one QA-only command designed to exceed a short timeout.

Verify:

- watchdog triggers
- process group terminates
- structured timed_out result is written
- no child process remains
- worker remains healthy
- queue accepts the next job

Return:

- Job ID
- Command type
- Timeout value
- Signal used
- Orphan count
- Worker heartbeat
- Proof ledger ID

==================================================
9. RUN A FRESH OWNER-AUTHORIZED QA JOB
==================================================

Use a fresh owner session inside IVX.

Do not paste a Supabase token into Rork chat.

Required flow:

OWNER LOGIN
→ OWNER APPROVAL
→ SHORT-LIVED SINGLE-USE WORKER AUTHORIZATION
→ HMAC WORKER AUTH
→ QA JOB

QA job must verify:

- lint
- tests
- build verification
- /health
- /version
- public chat
- owner route without auth returns 401
- non-owner route returns 403
- worker heartbeat
- proof ledger persistence

Required result:

- final status: completed
- no hanging stage
- no manual cancellation

Return:

- Authorization ID
- Job ID
- Worker ID
- Approved SHA
- Final status
- Started/completed timestamps
- Proof ledger ID

==================================================
10. RUN ONE OWNER-AUTHORIZED DEPLOYMENT JOB
==================================================

After the QA job passes, run one real deployment job.

Required chain:

OWNER APPROVAL
→ TOKEN ISSUED
→ TOKEN CONSUMED
→ CHECKOUT
→ CI
→ BUILD
→ RENDER DEPLOY
→ HEALTH
→ VERSION
→ PROOF LEDGER
→ COMPLETED

The approval must bind:

- repository
- branch
- exact SHA
- worker ID
- production environment
- action
- expiration
- single use

Return:

- Authorization ID
- Deployment job ID
- Worker ID
- GitHub Actions run ID
- Approved SHA
- Executed SHA
- API deployment ID
- Worker deployment ID
- Website deployment ID
- Final status
- Proof ledger ID

==================================================
11. PROVE REPLAY REJECTION
==================================================

Attempt to reuse the same authorization.

Expected:

- request rejected
- no duplicate job
- no duplicate deployment
- no duplicate proof ledger completion

Return:

- HTTP status
- Error code
- Duplicate job count
- Duplicate deployment count
- Replay proof record

==================================================
12. VERIFY LIVE PRODUCTION
==================================================

Check:

- https://ivxholding.com
- /robots.txt
- /sitemap.xml
- https://api.ivxholding.com/health
- https://api.ivxholding.com/version
- public chat
- owner route without auth
- owner route with valid owner session
- worker status
- worker heartbeat
- latest completed job
- queue depth

Expected:

- Website HTTP 200
- robots HTTP 200
- sitemap HTTP 200
- /health HTTP 200
- /version HTTP 200
- GitHub HEAD = API SHA = Worker SHA = /version SHA
- Public chat HTTP 200
- Missing owner auth returns 401
- Valid owner request succeeds
- Worker heartbeat healthy
- Latest job completed

==================================================
13. REMOVE REMAINING RORK IOS CONFIG
==================================================

After autonomous deployment passes:

- rotate any exposed iOS toolkit credential
- remove Rork variables from ios-ivx-holdings/.env
- remove obsolete Rork fields from Config.swift
- remove Rork URL schemes
- remove Rork endpoints
- remove Rork build scripts
- verify no Rork SDK/package remains

Never print secret values.

Return:

- Credential rotated: YES / NO
- Variables removed
- Files changed
- Reader count after removal
- Secret scan result

==================================================
14. MIGRATE IOS IDENTITY
==================================================

Replace any Rork-namespaced bundle IDs with an IVX-owned identifier.

Use the owner-approved final bundle ID.

Update:

- targets
- schemes
- entitlements
- signing
- provisioning
- push identifiers
- app groups
- keychain groups
- associated domains
- deep links

Required:

- IVX-controlled Apple team
- IVX signing identity
- no Rork bundle ID
- no Rork provisioning
- no Rork associated domain

No App Store submission now.

==================================================
15. MIGRATE ANDROID IDENTITY
==================================================

Replace:

com.rork.ivxholdings

with the owner-approved IVX application ID.

Replace:

Theme.RorkApp

with:

Theme.IVXHoldings

Update:

- namespace
- applicationId
- package declarations
- Java/Kotlin directories
- imports
- manifest
- intent filters
- deep links
- Firebase config if used
- Gradle
- tests
- release scripts
- APK validation

Required:

- no com.rork.* namespace
- no Theme.RorkApp
- no Rork signing identity
- no Rork SDK
- no Rork deep link

==================================================
16. RECONCILE RENDER.YAML
==================================================

Update render.yaml to reference:

ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform

Remove:

- old repository name
- old Rork paths
- obsolete environment groups
- Rork deploy hooks
- Rork build commands

Verify:

- API service
- worker service
- main branch
- build/start commands
- health path
- environment groups
- auto-deploy

Do not create duplicate services.

==================================================
17. REMOVE RORK SYNC DEPENDENCY
==================================================

The required development path must be:

IVX DEVELOPER OR IVX WORKER
→ STANDARD GIT
→ GITHUB
→ GITHUB ACTIONS
→ RENDER
→ HEALTH/VERSION

Remove the requirement for:

- Rork sync layer
- Rork repository router
- Rork sandbox push
- Rork-specific build flow

Preserve only non-required historical tools if necessary until the final clean build passes.

==================================================
18. REMOVE RORK.JSON
==================================================

First map every required function still provided by rork.json.

Create IVX-owned replacements in:

- package scripts
- GitHub Actions
- standard build scripts

Then:

1. Remove all functional references.
2. Delete rork.json.
3. Run CI.
4. Build backend.
5. Build worker.
6. Build website.
7. Validate Expo.
8. Validate Android.
9. Validate iOS.
10. Deploy and verify.

Required:

rork.json present: NO

==================================================
19. REMOVE ALL RORK VARIABLES
==================================================

After reader count equals zero, remove:

- EXPO_PUBLIC_RORK_*
- RORK_*
- toolkit variables
- Rork URLs
- Rork project IDs
- Rork tokens
- Rork secrets

Audit:

- Render API
- Render worker
- environment groups
- GitHub Actions
- Expo/EAS
- iOS
- Android
- Supabase functions
- local templates

Return names and statuses only.

==================================================
20. CLEAN-ROOM BUILD
==================================================

Run from an IVX-controlled GitHub Actions runner or another independent environment.

Conditions:

- fresh clone
- no Rork login
- no Rork session
- no Rork API key
- no Rork SDK
- no Rork variables
- no rork.json
- no Rork sync
- no Rork build service

Execute:

- install
- lint
- typecheck
- unit tests
- integration tests
- security scan
- secret scan
- backend build
- worker build
- website build
- Expo validation
- Android APK build
- iOS validation
- API start
- worker start
- /health
- /version
- owner-approved QA job

==================================================
21. FINAL ZERO-RORK AUDIT
==================================================

Return exact active counts:

- Rork APIs
- Rork SDKs
- Rork packages
- Rork variables
- Rork domains
- Rork runtime calls
- Rork build dependencies
- Rork CI dependencies
- Rork deployment dependencies
- Rork authentication dependencies
- Rork telemetry
- Rork webhooks
- Rork assets
- Rork iOS identifiers
- Rork Android identifiers
- rork.json
- Rork sync required

Every active count must be 0.

Historical documentation and defensive blocklists must be reported separately and must not be counted as active dependencies.

==================================================

==================================================

- worker no longer hangs
- fresh QA job completes
